coordinateSystem: top-left pixel centers; u=(x+0.5)/width, v=(y+0.5)/height; x/y are subpixel source centroids

algorithm.detection: 2048px Lanczos proxy; strict 5x5 local maxima; local contrast against sigma=3px Gaussian background
algorithm.refinement: Original-resolution 39x39 windows; outer-annulus median background; sigma=0.55px denoise; contrast-weighted core centroid within 9px
algorithm.photometry: sRGB channel values, Rec.709 brightness weights; no photo asset changed
